question: The cultural festival of Ratha Saptami is mainly celebrated in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** cultural festival of Ratha Saptami is mainly celebrated in Andhra Pradesh, India**
 
• The** festival is celebrated at the Sri Suryanarayana Swamy temple in Arasavalli, Srikakulam. **
 
• The** festival is considered the birth day of the Sun God, Lord Surya Narayana Swamy.**
 
• The Andhra Pradesh government has declared Ratha Saptami as a state festival to recognize its cultural and spiritual importance.
 
• The** festival is celebrated in the month of February or March, which is the month of Magha in the English calendar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Andhra Pradesh

 
 
• It was formed in its present form in 1956.
 
• It was the result of the demand of the Andhras for a separate state.
 
• After Potti Sriramulu died while fasting for the creation of Andhra Pradesh, the state came into existence in this scenario.
 
• Although it is primarily agricultural, the state has some mining activity and a significant amount of industry.
